newsitem.title: USA: USDA ups 1997 wheat price for crop insurance.
newsitem.headline: USDA ups 1997 wheat price for crop insurance.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Friday said the 1997 wheat price election for crop insurance would be $3.85 per bushel, eight percent above 1996.
USDA said about 80 percent of the 1996 planted wheat acreage was insured. The price was $3.55 per bushel.
"The higher price provides wheat growers the protection they need and encourages participation at higher levels of coverage," Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said in a statement.
The 1997 durum price election is also $3.85 per bushel.
The price elections are based on USDA's assessments of supply and demand factors for the 1997 crop as well as indications from the futures markets, the department said.
USDA noted the sales closing date for fall-planted wheat crop insurance is Sept. 30 for many regions of the country.
